abstract: This Stanford/World Bank study examines the labor market impacts of generative AI adoption among US workers through December 2025. The research finds that 35.9% of US workers have adopted generative AI tools, with associated small positive wage effects and no significant decline in job openings, suggesting AI adoption has not yet produced widespread labor market disruption.
keyFindings: 35.9% of US workers used generative AI by December 2025.
Generative AI adoption is associated with small positive wage effects.
No significant decline in job openings observed despite widespread AI adoption.
